summary: PEO Middle East helps companies hire, onboard, and manage compliant workforces across the Middle East through Professional Employer Organization (PEO), Employer of Record (EOR), payroll, and HR solutions.
details: Based in Dubai and part of Connect Group, PEO Middle East supports regional expansion with PEO/EOR, payroll outsourcing, immigration, and relocation services across UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait, Egypt, Turkey, and more.
blogNote: Insights cover PEO vs EOR, Middle East hiring, payroll outsourcing, immigration, and workforce compliance.
